title: Establishment of a mapped EPS security context during intersystem handover

entities.name: Establishment of mapped EPS security context during intersystem handover
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a mapped EPS security context during inter-system handover from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode in EMM-CONNECTED mode. Involves derivation of security keys and algorithms.

entities.name: NAS security transparent container for handover to E-UTRAN
entities.description: Container that carries NAS security parameters including selected NAS algorithms, nonceMME, and KSISGSN during handover to E-UTRAN.

entities.name: K 'ASME
entities.description: Derived intermediate key used to generate EPS NAS keys during mapped security context establishment.

entities.name: KSISGSN
entities.description: Key Set Identifier for SGSN security context, associated with K 'ASME in mapped EPS security context.

entities.name: nonceMME
entities.description: Nonce generated by MME used in derivation of K 'ASME for mapped EPS security context.

entities.name: EPS NAS keys
entities.description: NAS security keys derived from K 'ASME for EPS security context.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer services with no UMTS security context
entities.description: Condition where UE has emergency PDN connection but no current UMTS security context, requiring special security handling.

entities.name: EIA0 and EEA0 NAS security algorithms
entities.description: Null integrity and ciphering algorithms used for emergency bearer services when no UMTS security context exists.

entities.name: Mapped EPS security context
entities.description: Security context established during inter-system handover, derived from previous system security parameters.

relations.description: The procedure uses the NAS security transparent container to transport security parameters.
The container carries the nonceMME parameter for K 'ASME derivation.
The container carries the KSISGSN identifier associated with K 'ASME.
The procedure establishes K 'ASME as an intermediate security key.
K 'ASME is used to derive EPS NAS keys for the security context.
Emergency bearer condition requires use of EIA0 and EEA0 algorithms.
Emergency condition leads to establishment of locally generated mapped security context.
The procedure establishes the mapped EPS security context during handover.
